# Essential Urgent Rules

## 🚨 CRITICAL RULES
- ✅ User agents → `user-agent.config.js` (NEVER hardcode)
- ✅ All errors → logging service + severity
- ✅ Web security + context isolation → ALL webviews
- ✅ Inheritance → BaseProvider/BaseCLI (not modules)
- ✅ Code structure → JSDoc descriptions guide behavior
- ✅ JSDoc sync → reflect functional changes
- ✅ Check services → before new implementations

**⚠️ Preservation Statement:**
Essential protocol requirements preserved. Implementation details reduced.
